name: MapView
whenToUse: Where places are: stores, pickup points, studios, clinics — and which one is nearest.
A small set of places a person picks from (tens to a few hundred), with an address for each.

whenNotToUse.text: One address on a contact page
whenNotToUse.instead: a link to a maps app next to the address

whenNotToUse.text: A decorative picture of a map in a hero
whenNotToUse.instead: an illustration — it doesn’t need tiles or WebGL

anatomy.description: MapLibre with a base map drawn from tokens: land on surface-sunken, water on info-subtle, parks on success-subtler, roads on surface with border casings, labels in text-subtle. Recolored on a theme or brand change. Tiles from OpenFreeMap by default (`tiles`); `tiles={null}` draws points only.
a 14px dot in the primary color with a surface ring; the selected one grows to 20px — size marks it, not only color.
nearby points merge into a primary circle with the count; click to zoom in. Off with `cluster={false}`.
top end corner; disabled at the zoom limits.
over the map, bottom start (full width on a phone), for the selected place: name, address, distance — or your content via `renderCard`. Closes with its × button.
the same places with address and distance, next to the map (`list="end"` or `"start"`) and under it on a phone. Sorted by distance once there is an `origin`.
asks for the location, sorts the list and selects the nearest place (`locate`).

do.caption: The places are also a list with addresses and distances: it works by keyboard, by screen reader, and when the map can’t load.
do.example:
• Helios Studio · 0.4 km
  • Pickup · Graça · 0.6 km
  • Eos Portraits · 0.9 km

dont.caption: A map as the only way to find a place shuts out everyone who can’t see it or use a pointer.

a11y: The map is never the only way in: the list carries every place with its address and is the keyboard and screen-reader path. Keep it; list="none" only when the same places are listed elsewhere on the page.
Markers mirror the list for the pointer: they are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers, so places aren’t announced twice. Each has its name as a tooltip.
The map canvas takes focus: arrows pan, + and − zoom; it is named so people know what the keys do. The zoom buttons work without the canvas.
Selecting a place moves the map, not the focus; the card is a named group. "Find near me" announces the result (nearest place and distance) or the failure, and the list stays usable either way.
Under reduced motion the map jumps instead of flying.
Without WebGL the frame says the map can’t be shown and the list works as usual.
Name the map region with `aria-label` (“Our studios”) and the list with `listTitle`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the map region, e.g. "Our restaurants". Defaults to the dictionary's "Map".

props.name: center
props.description: Start center; defaults to the middle of the points.

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby points into clusters with a count.

props.name: height
props.description: Map height on wide screens; on a phone the map is 320px tall.

props.name: list
props.description: Where the list goes on wide screens (it always goes under the map on a phone). `none` only when the same places are listed elsewhere on the page.

props.name: locate
props.description: Show the "Find near me" button above the list.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where distances are measured from. Controlled: pass with onOriginChange; otherwise set by "Find near me".

props.name: renderCard
props.description: Body of the card over the map for the selected point; the default shows name, address and distance.

props.name: tiles
props.description: Vector tiles (a TileJSON URL in the OpenMapTiles schema). `null` draws no base map: points on the land color only.

props.name: unit
props.description: Distance unit in the list and card.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Start zoom; defaults to a zoom that fits every point.
